notes.title: Small optimization improvement
notes.content: Added extra coding for those playing on low performance PCs to help with rendering projectiles and getting them to hit the proper distances

notes.title: Update 1.11
notes.content:
[h3][b]We have been working even when the universe does not allow us...
[/b][/h3]

We bring new content:

[h2]New weapon.[/h2]
Spinning Glaive
A kinetic weapon of medium power but with the ability to ricochet off each target it touches to hit another one. This weapon comes with a whole set of Elite power-ups and upgrades.

[h2]New Secret Mission.[/h2]
A secret mission that refers to a great science fiction movie of all time. Like all secret missions, it has a very low chance to appear and only has one successful outcome. Successfully completing the mission will unlock 2 new power-ups for all future runs.

[h2]New power-ups.[/h2]
Added 16 new power-ups that can drop as a reward in every run.

Error correction

[list]
[*] Fixed issue in ESCAPE missions where when some turrets fired their shell would immediately explode.
[*] The error with some texts was fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Important update
notes.content:
Important update

New content has been added and some improvements have been made based on your retro... thanks for your feedback.
Content:
-Added 20 new power-ups that can drop as a reward.
-Added 1 new secret mission
-Added a new secret enemy

Improvements:
-Popups take 2 seconds to appear to allow better viewing of the various upgrade, mutator, and unlockable menus.
-The main menu button for language change can now be activated by pressing the letter "X" on the keyboard, left clicking on the icon or pressing the "X" button on the controller.
-You can now also navigate between power-ups by pressing the arrows on your keyboard.
-A feature of the game is that after making a choice, it waits a couple of seconds, giving you the opportunity to change your choice and vote again (very useful for multiplayer), but this appeared to be a bug for some users. Therefore, now when you vote for the second time or change your decision, instead of an arrow appearing, a vote change symbol will appear.
-Instructions from combat missions that were previously automatically skipped after a few seconds are now up to the user, meaning the player will need to press "A" on the controller or "Enter" on the keyboard when ready to proceed. (No more waiting or otherwise, you can take your time to read)

Defender... Medium unit that serves as a barrier to protect key units.

New miniboss level (Interceptor)... On difficulties above level 4 increase the number of heavy missiles by 1xplayer and launch 4 rotating laser blades to complicate the scenario.

notes.title: DEMO Update 1.003
notes.content:
[h1]-Content[/h1]
[h2]New enemies[/h2]
[h3]MineLayer:[/h3] Slow but resistant ship. Randomly throws mines that deal splash damage when detonated after some time or when destroyed.
[h3]Disruptor:[/h3] Small ship of medium range, they are weak, but their attacks can interrupt the capture of neutral stations for a period of time.
[h3]Raptor: [/h3]Small and fast medium-range ship, they are not very resistant and usually attack neutral stations or the base with their linear laser.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790975/40a4b82d4f5bf37b40d5a73db27b2d848f66181a.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790975/a435d1014154f64fed3e379b6090ef0d7d41e567.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790975/6f0d5b376a7f3eb032c2efb8bb3df7a2d5a34e47.png[/img]
[h2]Added secret missions[/h2]
Added two Decision Missions that have a 2% chance to drop each run.
These quests have only one correct option and grant unique and permanent rewards upon completion. If the mission is chosen incorrectly, it has a chance to appear again, instead, if it is solved correctly, this mission will not appear again.

[h2]New Mini Boss of Secret Mission[/h2]
Relay station
Huge foe with multi-directional and powerful attacks, it also has attacks capable of deflecting projectiles.

[h2]New mission station capture by time[/h2]
Timed neutral station capture mission.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790975/c0a759c5ee9a25c63ef02a95886665a7bb77da56.png[/img]

[h2]System of initial bonuses and penalties[/h2]
At the beginning of each game you will receive initial bonuses that will last only for the current run, you can also receive penalties from ????? You'll find out who.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790975/8e03f463e4dc214f583d2ca0ba5e309525eb351a.png[/img]

[h1]-Bug fix[/h1]
Fixed the issue where only one station to capture would appear instead of the usual 2, preventing you from completing the mission.
Fixed bug where disabling friendly fire prevented taking damage from enemy explosions.
